title: Australia passes the News Bargaining Incentive, which will tax tech giants 2.5% on their Australian ad revenue unless they strike deals with local news media (Christine Chen/Reuters)
summary: Christine Chen / Reuters: Australia passes the News Bargaining Incentive, which will tax tech giants 2.5% on their Australian ad revenue unless they strike deals with local news media — Australia passed legislation on Thursday that will force tech giants to pay millions of dollars in levies if they fail …
